mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed arc shows the hidden part of the cylinder’s circular bottom rim. Right image: The dashed trace is the graph of g.
Rationales: The feature shows the occluded part of the circular rim of a solid in the left image and plots the values of a function in the right image. The dashed arc at the rear of the lower cylinder rim. The dashed magenta parabola labeled g, with a vertex left of the y-axis.
